n. 停止
v. 中止, 停止

surceased.translation: 中止, 停止( surcease的过去式和过去分词 )

surceases.translation: 中止, 停止( surcease的第三人称单数 )

surcharge.definition:
n. an additional charge (as for items previously omitted or as a penalty for failure to exercise common caution or common skill)
v. charge an extra fee, as for a special service
v. fill to capacity with people
v. print a new denomination on a stamp or a banknote
surcharge.translation:
n. 装载过多, 超载, 追加罚款, 附加税
vt. 使装载过多, 追加罚款, 收附加税

surcharged.translation:
n. 超载；额外费
vt. 追加罚款；使…装载过多；使…负担过重

surcharges.definition:
n an additional charge (as for items previously omitted or as a penalty for failure to exercise common caution or common skill)
v charge an extra fee, as for a special service
v rip off; ask an unreasonable price
v fill to capacity with people
v print a new denomination on a stamp or a banknote
v fill to an excessive degree
v place too much a load on
v show an omission in (an account) for which credit ought to have been given
surcharges.translation: n. 附加费, 额外费用( surcharge的名词复数 )

surcharging.definition: p. pr. & vb. n. of Surcharge
surcharging.translation:
n. 超载；额外费
vt. 追加罚款；使…装载过多；使…负担过重

surcingle.definition:
n. A belt, band, or girth which passes over a saddle, or
   over anything laid on a horse's back, to bind it fast.
n. The girdle of a cassock, by which it is fastened round
   the waist.
surcingle.translation:
n. 肚带, (法衣)腰带
vt. 套上肚带, 用腰带束

surcingled.translation:
vt. 套上肚带；用腰带束
n. 肚带；法衣的腰带

surcoat.definition:
n. a loose outer coat usually of rich material
n. a tunic worn over a knight's armor

surcoats.definition:
plural of surcoat
n. a loose outer coat usually of rich material
n. a tunic worn over a knight's armor

surculose.definition: a. Producing suckers, or shoots resembling suckers.
